correctness.rationale: The unique maximum independent set consists of h and all attached leaves and has size d. Classifying size d−1 sets with/without h gives c_{d−1}−c_1=I(H[A];1)−1−a=sum_{j>=2}i_j(H[A]); its nonnegative vanishing is exactly the clique condition. If A is a clique, decomposing independent core subsets U in B and optionally one allowable A vertex proves I(W;x)=(1+x)^d I(H-h;x/(1+x)^2) as a polynomial identity. All gamma coefficients are i_j(H-h)>=0. For every negative real root tau of I(H-h;t), tau(1+x)^2=x has two distinct negative roots, and the converse follows by preimages of roots; real-rootedness iff. Independent literal enumeration of all small rooted H for 244 cases, checking the top coefficients and symmetry, agreed.

final_claim: For finite graph H with h having neighbor set A nonempty and complementary B, one leaf attached per A vertex, two per B vertex, none at h, independence polynomial of W is palindromic of degree d=a+2b+1 iff A is a clique, equivalently h simplicial. Its coefficient defect is sum_{j>=2}i_j(H[A]); in that case I(W;x)=(1+x)^d I(H-h;x/(1+x)^2), gamma positive, and real-rootedness transfers exactly.
